base_style: Brutalist comic strip rendered in thick, shaking, hand-drawn charcoal lines on yellowed, heavy-grain parchment with heavy charcoal vignetting and physical lens damage effects (vertical scratches, lens grease, dried splatter).
characters: Sweat-slicked, tense, and expressive figures contrasted with mechanical, vacant-eyed doppelgangers. Rendered with varying levels of detail, dissolving into dark, muddy silhouettes in wide/chaotic shots. Dynamic lighting creates sickly mustard highlights and deep, reaching bruised-purple shadows.
color_palette: 'The Bruise & The Bile' theme: sickly mustard yellows, deep bruised purples, dried-scab red accents, sickly green glows, and heavy, bubbling charcoal blacks over heavy-grained yellowed parchment and smog-choked grey light.
layout_and_composition: 5-panel strip with uneven, hand-carved charcoal border lines. Composition relies on high-tension cinematic camera work (shaky action perspectives, extreme close-ups, and long-shot shadow silhouettes) obscured by physical environmental textures like smog, lens grease, and splatter.
lettering_and_dialog: Dialogue bubbles are hand-torn, graying vellum strips with cramped, ink-blotted, shaky calligraphy and precise tiny script to reflect character emotion. SFX are large, jagged charcoal letters scratched directly into the panel artwork.
text_rendering_guide: Dialogue: Hand-torn graying vellum strips, cramped ink-blotted calligraphy (shaky or precise depending on tone). Captions: N/A. Voice Over: N/A. Chyrons: N/A. Sound Effects: Raw, jagged charcoal lettering scratched into environmental surfaces/backgrounds (e.g., *CREEEEEEAK...*, *SKREEEEEEEEEE!*, *THWIP—SQUELCH!*).
